turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
nch overseas territories.

For Switzerland, the displayed price includes Swiss VAT, logistics costs, and customs fees. If the carrier asks you to pay customs fees, please send us the corresponding PDF invoice so Tediber can settle the amount directly with the carrier.

For the other listed European destinations, shipping and logistics costs are included in the displayed price. You can find the full details here: https://hello.tediber.com/fr-FR/articles/tout-sur-la-livraison-278456

Best regards,

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
France: generally 24 to 48 hours, provided no old-bedding removal is requested.
Large items or orders containing a bed base or sofa: different delivery times apply. The available date is shown during checkout, subject to stock.
European deliveries: approximately 72 hours.

The exact earliest date for your address and products is displayed on the product page and during checkout. Full details are available here: https://hello.tediber.com/fr-FR/articles/tout-sur-la-livraison-278456

Best regards,

d. Damage, missing parts, dirt, or abnormal signs of use may lead to a deduction from the refund.

turns.q: What payment methods do you accept for an order?
turns.replyTail:
You can pay for an online order with:

CB, Visa, Mastercard, or American Express
PayPal, where available at checkout
Instalment payment from 3 to 12 times for eligible purchases between €50 and €8,000. Payment in 3 or 4 instalments is interest-free.

Checks and bank transfers are not accepted for online orders. The payment methods available for your order will be shown at checkout.
